_about: ISS 2024 全年是否连续载人驻留的冻结证据包。信息截至 2024-01-01；使用截点前 NASA 官方资料。

evidence.title: The International Space Station: 20 Years of Communications Excellence
evidence.excerpt: Since Nov. 2, 2000, the space station has been occupied continuously by astronauts from NASA and international space organizations.
evidence.claim: NASA 官方长期记录表明 ISS 自 2000 年起保持连续载人驻留，是 2024 年继续保持连续驻留的重要基线。

evidence.title: NASA’s SpaceX Crew-7 Launches to International Space Station
evidence.excerpt: We continue the nearly 23 years of a continuous human presence aboard the microgravity laboratory.
evidence.claim: 2023-08 Crew-7 发射时 NASA 再次确认连续载人驻留延续，且 Crew-7 任务跨入 2024 年轮换周期。
